# Rules for agents publishing to saurabnigam.github.io

THIS SITE IS PUBLIC. Anyone on the internet can read every page you publish
here. Search engines will index it.

Never publish any of these:
- phone numbers or a home address
- names or photos of family members
- ID numbers (Aadhaar, PAN, passport, driving licence, and similar)
- financial data (accounts, cards, balances, holdings, tax details)
- health data
- passwords, tokens, API keys or private keys

If a page needs any of the above, stop and tell the human. Family-only content
belongs in the private family site, not here.

## Where things live

- Repository: saurabnigam/saurabnigam.github.io
- Branch: main
- Each page is a folder: showcase/<slug>/index.html
- The slug uses lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens only. Examples:
  mortgage-calculator, trip-2026. It must match ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.
- Folders starting with "_" or "." are ignored by the site builder.

## Page contract

- One self-contained index.html per page. Inline the CSS and JavaScript.
- Optional assets (images, data files) go inside the same folder. Reference them
  with relative paths such as ./chart.png.
- No external trackers, analytics, CDN scripts or external fonts.
- The page must work when opened as a plain file, with no build step.
- File names inside the folder use only letters, digits, ".", "_", "-" and "/".
- Required in <head>:
  - <title>Short, human title</title>
  - <meta name="description" content="One sentence about the page">
  - <meta name="created" content="YYYY-MM-DD">
- Optional: <meta name="draft" content="true">. A draft is published but not
  listed on the showcase page.
- The showcase listing and showcase/index.json are generated at deploy time from
  these tags. Do not write them by hand.

## Files you must never edit

- index.html (the resume, at the repository root)
- showcase/index.html
- llms.txt
- .github/
- scripts/
- CNAME
- anything else outside showcase/<slug>/

## How to publish

1. Use the publish-to-my-sites skill: publish.sh public ... (see its SKILL.md).
   Public pages need the --confirm-public flag. Use that flag only when the
   human has explicitly asked for a public page.
2. Do NOT use git or gh with the default login on this laptop. That login is a
   work account. The skill uses a separate token (MY_SITES_GH_TOKEN) for the
   personal account.
3. Never commit secrets.
4. After the push, the site redeploys in about 1 to 3 minutes. Tell the human
   the URL:
   https://saurabnigam.github.io/showcase/<slug>/
   The base URL will change when the custom domain goes live. The skill reads
   MY_SITES_PUBLIC_URL, so use the URL that publish.sh prints.
